==Description==
'''Shared Optics''' is a buff that allows a tower to see in the range of another tower.

==Mechanics==
'''Shared Optics''' is currently unique to the [[Operator]]. It allows an [[Operator]] to see in the range of another [[Operator]] with [[Shared Optics]] if it is in its range. If the [[Operator]] the tower is taking the range from has other [[Operator]]s in its range, then it will be able to attack in their range too. This allows players to form a network of [[Operator]]s across a large area. '''Shared Optics''' is unlocked by the [[Operator]] at Level 5.

==Applied By==
The following towers can apply '''Shared Optics''' to other towers:
*[[Operator]] (Passive)
